There are two different components in play here:

- The input processor which directly operates on the user input to reserve placeholders for the image features (registered using `INPUT_REGISTRY.register_input_processor` and called in `LLMEngine`).
- The input mapper which calls the HuggingFace processor to preprocess the image (registered using `MULTIMODAL_REGISTRY.register_image_input_mapper` and called in `ModelRunner`).

For reference, the overall pipeline is noted [here](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/dev/input_processing/input_processing_pipeline.html#input-processing-pipeline).
